page.overview:
Who is Sealey?

Captain Sealey lead a cover ops team known as Dead-Man's Hand.

In 1997, Sealey lead several mercenaries into a jungle near the Guatemalan/Mexican border. There, they were joined by Batman. With Batman and his team, Sealey found a alien spacecraft.
